_desc: OPTIONAL /terminal page (enable in config.json) — shell setup guide (prerequisites, install one-liner, config steps, collapsible config panels, source-repo card) + its home 'Development' card.

_fields.subtitle: Page subtitle. Reference: 'Below is my terminal setup configuration.'
_fields.homeCardDescription: One-liner on the home card. Reference: 'Zsh, Starship, Fastfetch, and shell configuration.'
_fields.prerequisites: [{ name, description }] shown as numbered rows. Reference: Zsh / Git / Homebrew.
_fields.installCommand: Install one-liner rendered as a copyable code block (use \n for line breaks), OR point installCommandFile at a text file instead.
_fields.configFiles: [{ title, file, language }] — each renders as a collapsible 'Show' panel with copy. Example: .zshrc, fastfetch config. Put contents in files like 'content/terminal-zshrc.txt'.
_fields.sourceRepo: { name, url, description } for the 'Source Repository' card at the bottom. Reference: ramxcodes/term-conf. Leave name "" to omit the card.
